cases.evidence: JodiUSA identity-bound free grant preserved and existing Starter quotas tested. Complete synthetic member activation, matching, saved-state and return-browser checks pass. Actual operator-demo review/community validation and broader free-product operational release prerequisites remain open; this is not a full launch approval.

Full existing-tier catalogue entitlement matrix passes this run; earlier real failed-renewal/retry recovery evidence is retained. End-to-end external capabilities, owner plan-change/cancellation operations, production paid-provider setup and full retry-exhaustion policy still require evidence. Proposed paid tiers are not approved or activated.

249 actual HTTP assertions verify existing 8/25/100 daily limits, enterprise unlimited matching beyond 100, denied overflow, idempotent repeats, pass at cap, next-day reset, admission denial without user/invitation side effects and recovery after deletion. PostgreSQL additionally verifies concurrent final slot/like, bulk admission, tenant moves, expired/future plans and metadata ceilings. JodiUSA commercial caps remain unlimited. Operational resource/rate limits and third-party service quotas are outside this commercial usage gate.

Actual owner-console HTTP and runtime assertions cover all 27 catalogue keys across all four existing tiers (216 checks). Unavailable feature toggles return 403 and unavailable features stay off. Regression tests also forge enabled rows and test tenant/owner isolation; browser tests verify separate host sessions. Passing availability gates does not attest every external feature provider.

Standard Checkout selected explicitly. Actual hosted test payment returns to application, signed callback activates correct tenant, monthly renewal and annual interval/unpaid denial pass. Complete owner-initiated plan-management journey remains open.

Twelve final provider recovery assertions pass through registered signed HTTPS. Includes pending-to-success, success-to-failure, exact reversal, failed refund notice, signed records and late-event stability. Three real original events were resent. Invalid binding and API outage roll back acknowledgement; concurrent duplicate reversals pass on PostgreSQL. All cross-event ordering and production alert/retry operations are not fully certified.

Scheduled cancellation retains current access; actual test-clock natural expiry deactivates local access and removes paid tier, signed deletion recorded. Explicit cancellation also passes. Customer-facing cancellation-management journey remains open.

Supported USD single-payment refund flow passes: 9 real-provider refund assertions plus 4 partial/full ledger assertions and 2 operator-browser refund assertions. Pending refunds are not settled cash; successful refunds debit once; later failure credits once and flags follow-up. Signed delayed events, real replay, invalid bindings, outages and concurrent reversals are tested. No automatic replacement payment or refund of real funds. Unsupported proration/multi-payment scope is excluded.

products.note: Activation/quota fixes deployed. 437 PostgreSQL checks, 466 live-service HTTP assertions and 17 browser assertions pass. Existing-tier feature matrix, finite daily quotas, replay/concurrency and member admission boundaries verified; JodiUSA free grant preserved. Usage and cross-tier cases pass within the documented scope. Broader journey/entitlement approval remains blocked by operator-demo review and remaining operational/provider gates. Proposed paid tiers remain pending; no outreach.
